data.one_liner: Common platform interface for the file_picker federated plugin.
data.what_it_does: Defines the shared platform contract and data structures used across platform implementations of the file_picker plugin. It establishes the base FilePickerPlatform interface and data models like PlatformFile. App developers typically consume this indirectly through the main file_picker package.
use_when: You are developing a custom platform-specific implementation of file_picker.
You need to extend or mock the FilePickerPlatform interface directly in custom tooling or tests.
avoid_when: You simply want to pick files in an application (use the main file_picker package instead).
strengths: Enforces a uniform API and contract across all supported platforms (Android, iOS, Web, desktop).
Uses plugin_platform_interface to ensure consistent platform registration.
weaknesses: Not intended for direct use in end-user application code.
